_doc: Scheduler settings compared. All runs: vLLM 0.32.0, --scheduling-policy priority, --max-num-batched-tokens 2048, chunked prefill. 'ctrl' is written to $VLLM_SCHED_CTRL (thr = long_prefill_token_threshold, adaptive = long_prefill_token_threshold_adaptive, pcap = PR #65283 priority_prefill_budget_cap with its default 16 tokens). 'equal' = every request priority 0, i.e. FCFS order.
